definitions.explanation: In logic and computing, the operation that returns true when at least one of its inputs is true. Corresponds to the OR operator.

examples.japanese: {論理和|ろんりわ}を{計算|けいさん}する。
OR{回路|かいろ}は{論理和|ろんりわ}を{出力|しゅつりょく}する。
examples.english: An OR circuit outputs the logical OR.

examples.japanese: {論理和|ろんりわ}は、どちらか{一方|いっぽう}でも{真|しん}なら{真|しん}になる。
examples.english: A logical OR is true if either one of the inputs is true.

notes:
Formed from {論理|ろんり} (logic) plus {和|わ} (sum), the Japanese term for logical disjunction (OR).

RELATED WORDS:
- {論理積|ろんりせき}: logical AND (conjunction)
- {否定|ひてい}: logical NOT (negation)
- {排他的論理和|はいたてきろんりわ}: exclusive OR (XOR)
